assumptions.mode: Single-player ordinary Master, 7accessoryslots, Elaina hat, no other difficulty mods
assumptions.tank: 500 original max life ->300 life+200mana via AshenWitch; shield pays up to40% of incoming damage from current mana, no shield auto-drink
assumptions.health: Graduate assumes maintained nebula life regeneration9HP/s and available200HP potion /60s; first clear assumes2HP/s and150HP potion /60s. No lifesteal.
assumptions.firstClear: Stage18 cap90 excludes prototype.Lightning unlock91; hypotheticalFullFirstClear deliberately overrides this
assumptions.targeting: One eye at a time; boss-wide shared freeze meter, cooldown and frozen duration survive part deaths and stage transition. Wet remains per part. Core last; thunder hits one wet open target every.5s.
assumptions.AI: Extracted open/close schedule and frame transitions only. Boss-wide frozen state pauses all living eye clocks until consumed; no full movement, attacks, spatial distance or network simulation.
assumptions.limitations: No MoonLeech boss healing, real flight, actual reach limits, variable nebula buff pickups, randomly positioned arena. Hit/dodge/hurt profiles are illustrative rather than empirically calibrated.
assumptions.time: From spawn including1s appearance until coreHP0, excluding60s summoning countdown and death/loot animation.
